result.brief: 用连接组约束的果蝇视觉模型作为固定观察者，检验世界模型（MDN-RNN、RSSM）生成序列的缺陷是否在其神经响应中线性可解码，并提出检测视野与分级探针来评估世界模型rollout质量。
result.reason: Uses connectome-constrained fly visual model to probe whether world-model rollout artifacts are linearly decodable; concerns representation readout and world-model evaluation rather than new video representation learning.
